code: import pandas as pd import numpy as np import lightgbm as lgb from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split from joblib import Parallel, delayed sensor_geo = pd.read_csv("input/sensor_geometry.csv").set_index("sensor_id") def process_batch(batch_path): pulses = pd.read_parquet(batch_path).reset_index() pulses = pulses.join(sensor_geo, on="sensor_id") features = pulses.groupby("event_id").agg( { "charge": ["sum", "mean", "std", "max", "min"], "time": ["min", "max", lambda x: x.max() - x.min()], "auxiliary": "mean", "x": [ lambda x: np.average(x, weights=pulses.loc[x.index, "charge"]), "std", ], "y": [ lambda x: np.average(x, weights=pulses.loc[x.index, "charge"]), "std", ], "z": [ lambda x: np.average(x, weights=pulses.loc[x.index, "charge"]), "std", ], } ) features.columns = [ "charge_sum", "charge_mean", "charge_std", "charge_max", "charge_min", "time_min", "time_max", "time_span", "aux_ratio", "x_mean", "x_std", "y_mean", "y_std", "z_mean", "z_std", ] return features.reset_index() # Process training data with batch_id train_meta = pd.read_parquet( "input/train_meta.parquet", columns=["event_id", "azimuth", "zenith", "batch_id"] ) train_batches = [ f"input/train/batch_{i}.parquet" for i in train_meta["batch_id"].unique()[:5] # Use first 5 batches for speed ] # Process training features train_features = Parallel(n_jobs=4)(delayed(process_batch)(p) for p in train_batches) train_df = pd.concat(train_features).merge(train_meta, on="event_id").fillna(0) X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split( train_df.drop(["event_id", "azimuth", "zenith", "batch_id"], axis=1), train_df[["azimuth", "zenith"]], test_size=0.2, random_state=42, ) #
